h1: Voice agents that do the work of the call.
lede: CallOHM builds AI voice bots and calling agents that answer, qualify, book, remind and follow up in 30+ languages, with LLM-driven workflows and call analytics behind every conversation. It is offered as a pay-as-you-go SaaS platform and is the home of RabbiT, the agentic recruitment platform.

blocks.title: callohm.com: start with a free credit balance
blocks.body: Sign up, pick a voice and language, connect a number and run your first calls on prepaid credits, billed per minute with no volume commitment.

items.label: languages for inbound and outbound voice

blocks.text: Agentic AI in production, not in a demo

CallOHM is Purview’s most visible agentic product: real businesses route real calls through it every day. It proves the group can take frontier speech and language models, wrap them in the secure orchestration layer behind SAIE, and run them as a service with billing, analytics and support. The same stack powers RabbiT and the voice channels Purview builds for clients.
Inbound, outbound and everything around the call

items.title: AI voice bots
items.body: Inbound agents that answer, understand intent and resolve or route, in the caller’s language.

items.title: Calling agents
items.body: Outbound campaigns for reminders, confirmations, collections, surveys and lead qualification.

items.title: LLM voice workflows
items.body: Conversations that read and write to your systems: book, verify, update, escalate.

items.title: Call analytics

items.title: Telephony and CRM integration
items.body: SIP and cloud telephony, WhatsApp hand-off, CRM and ticketing connectors.

items.title: RabbiT recruitment
items.body: Voice screening, auto-scoring and interview scheduling for hiring at scale.

blocks.text: From script to live agent in days

items.title: Define the job
items.body: Decide what the agent must achieve on a call and what it must never do; set languages and voices.

items.title: Build the flow
items.body: Persona, knowledge, guardrails and system actions configured in the CallOHM dashboard.

items.title: Connect
items.body: Numbers, telephony, CRM and calendars linked; test calls run against real scenarios.

items.title: Launch
items.body: Go live on prepaid credits; agents scale to call volume without queues.

items.title: Learn
items.body: Analytics show outcomes and drop-offs; flows are tuned and new languages added.

blocks.text: What Purview runs behind the platform

items.title: A multi-model voice stack, orchestrated securely
items.body: CallOHM selects speech models per language from a panel of providers, orchestrates them with large language models through Purview’s secure engine, and runs telephony, billing and analytics as one managed service with human support.
